evidence.summary: The baseline configuration produced a score of 0.3544. Experiments that changed multiple input values produced lower scores of 0.1005, 0.1263 and 0.1717. A later near-baseline configuration produced 0.3455. This shows that the input combination has a strong effect on the score, but the experiments did not isolate individual feature effects.
The original configuration was observed to produce a score of 0.3544, which was higher than the scores from the multi-variable changes tested.
